summary: {person} has a board meeting on the calendar that depends on what the executive sends back.
realLife: Milwaukee supervisors announced a November 13 meeting conditional on budget vetoes, and Crowley signed without issuing any.
gates: The board reserved a date under its veto procedure.
weights: A tight budget calendar makes members reluctant to release the date early.
inGame: needs: conditional meeting notice, presentment, jurisdiction’s veto rules and executive response.

turns.what: The clerk confirms which item members will reconsider.
turns.pulledBy: The executive returns a veto in time.
turns.writesBack: Attach the message to the meeting notice.

turns.what: A supervisor checks the signed copy before clearing the time.
